name: au-cowork-personal
description: Room-centric collaboration over the shared ours.network daemon.

interface.shortDescription: Connect an agent to one persistent Cowork room.
interface.defaultPrompt: List my Cowork rooms and connect to the one I choose.
interface.longDescription: Connect one persistent agent room and invoke all r5/r11 product commands through authenticated, correlated MCP tools. Includes shared message retention, bounded files and body-free room notifications.
